modules.title: Module One: Business Fundamentals
modules.description: This module provides a solid foundation for understanding business management.

sub_modules.title: Introduction to Business Management
sub_modules.description: Understand the role of business management in organizational success.

activities.title: Defining Business Management
activities.description: Complete a quiz on the definition and scope of business management.
learning_objectives: LO 1.1: Define business management and its importance in organizational success.

activities.title: Business Environment Analysis
activities.description: Analyze the internal and external factors affecting a business.
learning_objectives: LO 1.2: Identify and analyze internal and external factors influencing business operations.

sub_modules.title: Module One Two: Business Structure and Governance
sub_modules.description: This module explains the different types of business structures and their impact on governance.

activities.title: Types of Business Structures
activities.description: Complete a quiz on the different types of business structures.
learning_objectives: LO 1.3: Explain the advantages and disadvantages of different business structures.
